name: Tatsu Dallas
dinnerNote: Sushi omakase, 15–18 courses (shorter omakase by the sous chef $99)

menus.name: Sushi omakase with Chef Tatsu
menus.note: Fifteen to eighteen courses: appetizers, 13 to 15 pieces of nigiri, a hand roll, miso soup and dessert. An 18% service charge is added; prepaid on Tock ($231 per person). Beverage pairings can be bought in advance.

menus.name: Short Omakase by the sous chef
menus.note: One appetizer and ten pieces of nigiri, served by Chef Yoji in the seven-seat Cherrywood room at 8:15pm. Plus the 18% service charge ($117 prepaid on Tock).

alsoTry.name: Kirameki
alsoTry.note: The cocktail bar hidden inside Tatsu Dallas, serving maki rolls made to order by the sous chef.

bookingOpens: Online on Tock only, as prepaid tickets for parties of one to four. Tables are released twice a month at 8am Dallas time: on the 1st for the 16th to the end of that month, and on the 15th for the 1st to the 15th of the next month. Concierge and third-party bookings are not accepted.
cancellation: Prepaid tickets are generally non-refundable. Guests who can't come are asked to transfer the booking on Tock first; otherwise the restaurant generally refunds cancellations made five calendar days or more ahead.
groups: Bookings are for one to four guests only. For a buyout (party of 10), email info@tatsu-dallas.com.
dressCode: No dress code is enforced, but most guests dress for a night out and very casual clothes may feel out of place. Guests are asked to go easy on perfume, cologne and scented lotion.
duration: One hour 45 minutes exactly, with seatings at 5:30pm and 7:45pm, Tuesday to Saturday. Arrive 15 minutes early: the full menu can't be promised to anyone more than 15 minutes late, and seatings are not extended.
